_comment: Per-game_code presentation fields that have no reliable official-metadata source and so cannot be safely auto-derived: a site URL path segment (renaming it would break live links) and the stage-state snapshot filename. Round-count/stage list is included explicitly too, since it is not currently a clean function of final_round_number (see tournament_context.py docstring) -- deriving it from a formula risked silently disagreeing with what the live site actually serves. venue/holes/format are sourced from the official getGameList response (see candidate/website-v2/data/next_event.json for the shape/provenance this was copied from) -- they are metadata-derived data, not invented, just not yet plumbed through scripts/01's collector into tournament_master.
